teaser: Tightening a bolt one more quarter turn, you stop and listen to the engine before calling it done. You are a 1, the number of the self-starter, crossed with an INTP, the mind that wants the mechanism explained before it is trusted. This crossing does not wait for permission to begin, and it does not want a crowd standing over the work. What is particular here is how fast conviction and curiosity trade places: certainty that you are right, undercut a moment later by the need to check why.
